_about: Hero images for every page except the home pages (and the iGaming pages, which use the Unsplash chips photo). Generate missing images with: python3 _tools/apply_heroes.py --generate ; apply to pages (safe to re-run after any page rebuild) with: python3 _tools/apply_heroes.py. Images: img/hero/<key>.jpg (2000×1125) and -sm.jpg (1000×562), generated with Higgsfield (Recraft V4.1 Pro) via _tools/gen_image.py. Blog posts made by build_post.py have their own images in img/blog/.

about.prompt: A quiet translator's studio in a historic Maltese limestone building: a solid wooden desk with neat stacks of documents, a fountain pen, a desk lamp glowing softly and bookshelves of dictionaries in several languages, tall shuttered window with Mediterranean light.

translators.prompt: Close-up of a professional translator's workspace seen from the side: hands-free composition with an open paper dictionary, a printed document with a pencil resting on it, a second monitor out of focus, a cup of coffee, warm window light; craft and concentration.

contact.prompt: A calm reception desk in a small Valletta office: a smartphone face down beside a notebook and pen, a brass desk bell, a sunlit arched limestone doorway in the background opening to a narrow street.

certified.prompt: Official-looking certificates and their translations laid side by side on a dark wooden desk, a rubber stamp and an ink pad beside them, a fountain pen, shallow depth of field so no writing is legible, warm side light.

website.prompt: A laptop and a smartphone on a desk showing abstract blurred website layouts in different colour blocks, a world map print softly out of focus on the wall behind, evening desk-lamp light.

igaming-latam.prompt: A sleek dark desk with a tablet showing an abstract blurred sports-betting interface, a football resting nearby, a few casino chips, and a softly lit window view of a Latin American city skyline at dusk.

museum.prompt: A dimly lit museum gallery with an ancient stone sculpture on a plinth, a blank exhibition label panel beside it, and a pair of audio-guide headphones resting on a bench in the foreground, soft spotlights.

writing.prompt: A writer's desk at golden hour: an open notebook with blurred handwriting, a laptop with an out-of-focus page layout, a mug and a small plant, Mediterranean light through the window.

languages.prompt: A shelf and desk filled with dictionaries and books in many languages, an antique globe in the corner, soft library light, shallow depth of field so no titles are readable.

blog.prompt: A reading nook by a window overlooking Valletta rooftops at sunrise: a stack of printed articles and magazines, a cup of coffee and reading glasses on a wooden side table.

legal.prompt: A tidy desk with a closed leather folder, a fountain pen and a small padlock resting on neatly stacked papers, calm and secure mood, soft light.

guide-residency.prompt: A family's personal documents gathered in a folder on a kitchen table in a Maltese home, house keys and a small model of a traditional Maltese balcony beside them, morning light.

guide-apostille.prompt: An embossed seal pressed into the corner of a document on a desk, a ribbon and a metal embosser beside it, macro photograph with very shallow depth of field so nothing is legible.

guide-sworn.prompt: Two documents side by side on a dark desk, one with a red wax seal and ribbon, one with an ink stamp, a balance scale ornament behind them, chiaroscuro light.

guide-igaming-latam.prompt: A smartphone on a café table showing a blurred colourful casino game interface, a few casino chips beside a coffee cup, a sunlit colonial street in Latin America out of focus behind.

lang-italian.prompt: Documents and a fountain pen on a desk by a window overlooking terracotta rooftops of an Italian city at golden hour, an espresso cup on the sill.

lang-french.prompt: Documents and a pen on a small table by a tall French window with a wrought-iron balcony overlooking Parisian zinc rooftops, soft morning light.

lang-german.prompt: A precise, orderly desk with documents and a pen in a modern office overlooking historic German half-timbered houses and a church spire, clear daylight.

lang-polish.prompt: Documents on a wooden desk by a window overlooking colourful historic townhouses of a Polish old-town market square, early evening light.

lang-romanian.prompt: Documents and a pen on a desk beside a window with a view of green Carpathian hills and a medieval Transylvanian town, soft afternoon light.

lang-russian.prompt: Documents and a fountain pen on a dark desk, a glass of tea in a metal holder, and a snowy classical city embankment visible through the window, blue-hour light.

lang-portuguese.prompt: Documents on a café table beside blue-and-white azulejo-tiled wall, a pastry and coffee, a sunlit hillside street with a yellow tram softly blurred behind.

lang-turkish.prompt: Documents and a pen on a desk with a tulip-shaped tea glass, a window view across the water to a skyline of domes and minarets at sunset, warm light.

lang-greek.prompt: Documents and a pen on a whitewashed windowsill desk overlooking the blue Aegean sea and white houses, bright clean Mediterranean light.

lang-dutch.prompt: Documents and a pen on a desk by a tall window overlooking a tree-lined canal with narrow gabled houses and a bicycle, soft overcast light.

lang-serbian.prompt: Documents and a pen on a desk overlooking a historic fortress on a hill above the meeting of two wide rivers, golden evening light.

lang-maltese.prompt: Documents and a pen on a limestone windowsill desk overlooking the Grand Harbour of Malta with honey-coloured fortifications and a traditional colourful luzzu boat, golden light.
